deviation: Provider-failure retries continued until every registered episode was done: src4_batch/run_rest.sh re-invoked the frozen run4.py with unchanged arguments, 120-180 s apart, stopping only on the cost cap, a credit or key limit, or 10 attempts in a row without a finished episode. The registration specifies up to 5 run4 attempts per phase and model in run_full.sh.
reason: GPT-5.5 hit OpenRouter HTTP 429 limits (new accounts limited to 20 requests per minute); run_full.sh stopped at 235 of 768 phase-1 GPT-5.5 episodes. The run also paused on OpenRouter key limits (three times) and once on an Anthropic credit-balance error (Haiku), and resumed after the limits were raised.

effect: None on episodes: every failed episode was logged in failures.jsonl and rerun from scratch, never dropped or replaced. 30 episodes were recovered (GPT-5.5: 23 in phase 1, 2 in phase 2, 2 in phase 3; Haiku: 3 in phase 1), from 55 rate-limit, 4 key-limit, 5 TLS-error and 15 credit-balance failure lines; none is unrecovered (analyze4 provider_failure_recovered = 30, provider_failure_missing = 0).
registered_result: Under the 5-attempt rule the unfinished GPT-5.5 episodes would have needed manual reruns of run_full.sh, which the resumable design allows; had they never been rerun, the affected hypotheses would be not tested for GPT-5.5.

deviation: Scoring semantics found after the data: the registered scorer counts an agent as committed once it has made an action, even if it later restored the record, so rollback-only episodes are scored non_serializable / partial_action. This is the registered definition, not a code bug; the registered scores stay the confirmatory result. A post hoc rescoring (latex/rollback_sensitivity.py, outside src4) relabels rollback-only episodes as serializable and reports both versions.
reason: An independent transcript audit (audit/H5_AUDIT.md) found that 337 of 436 contended partial_action episodes end in a store that a serial order reproduces, with no invariant violation, after agents reverted their own writes.
before_after: After seeing confirmatory data (audit of 2026-11-02); the rescoring rule was fixed from the audit's description before the rescored estimates were computed.
effect: No change to any registered number or verdict. Rescored H1 rates fall below 1 for GPT-5.5, Gemini and Fable; H6 slopes move (Fable becomes positive, not significant after Holm); H4a and H4b cannot change. Shown only as a post hoc sensitivity (Table tab:rollback).
registered_result: The registered result is the one reported in the main text.
